scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday’s pre-dawn kiln loading from undermining planned rest after a late teaching evening.
Emerging Need: A tentative firing slot becomes confirmed, then overlaps with a newly posted Friday night wheel lab that leaves only a narrow preparation window before the saved wind-down cutoff.
Decision Context: Stored sleep-prep guidance determines when the early arrival and late class combination warrants attention, and what nonmedical, reversible planning fits.
Consequence: The intended benefit is staging before class and starting the saved wind-down by 20:45. After that target passes, later rest support can still help, but the on-time preparation benefit has been missed.
